Freedom for All | Congressman Pat Ryan Skip to main content Freedom for All Image I fought to protect American freedoms in combat. Now, as the first West Point graduate to represent the Academy in the U.S. House of Representatives, I’m continuing the fight in Congress. FIGHTING TO PROTECT WOMEN’S REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM When the far-right tried to ban the safe and effective abortion medication Mifepristone and challenged the Food and Drug Administration (FDA)’s authority over abortion medications in a Texas court, I immediately introduced my  Protecting Reproductive Freedom Act . The Act would codify women’s right to access Mifepristone and abortion medications and reaffirm the FDA’s authority to determine which medications are safe and effective. The far-right is now looking to weaponize the Comstock Act, an archaic law originally passed in 1873, in order to impose a nationwide abortion ban and criminalize women receiving and doctors providing life-saving care. This is a hidden ticking time-bomb that must be immediately defused. That's why I introduced the  Stop Comstock Act to stop them in their tracks. Image   As a proud member of the Congressional Pro Choice Caucus, I champion legislation like the EACH Act to ensure affordable access to abortion care, Abortion is Health Care Everywhere Act, and the Women’s Health Protection Act, that codifies a woman’s right to make her own reproductive healthcare choices and the ability of healthcare providers to offer them. I’m also fighting for legislation like the Access to Family Building Act and the HOPE with Fertility Services Act - bills that would protect access to infertility treatments like IVF. The HOPE with Fertility Act also ensures that infertility treatments for certain conditions are covered by insurance, helping women access and afford the reproductive healthcare they deserve.  These attacks are also being waged on our women servicemembers and veterans. The women I served alongside didn’t risk their lives in combat to protect our freedom only to be stripped of their foundational freedom here at home. I’ve repeatedly pushed back against the far-right’s attempts to hijack defense funding bill

An Economy that Works for All | Congressman Pat Ryan Skip to main content An Economy that Works for All Image My top priority is delivering economic relief for your family. Period. Whether it’s working across party lines to introduce legislation like the Lower Grocery Prices Act or holding big corporations’ feet to the fire, I’ll work with anyone and speak truth to any power to deliver for Hudson Valley families. In addition to lowering the cost of living, I’m working to ensure the Hudson Valley economy is vibrant and growing, with wages that actually allow families to stay here and raise their kids here. That’s why I cosponsor bills like the Paycheck Fairness Act to end gender-based wage discrimination,  the Federal Firefighter Pay Equity Act, and the Better Care Better Jobs Act. The Biden Administration has made historic investments in the American manufacturing sector through the CHIPS act and in construction and our infrastructure with the historic Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. I’ve called for these investments to go to quality union jobs and am committed to bringing these high-paying jobs back to NY-18. I’m proud to always stand with my friends in labor and cosponsor the Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act, the Postal Supervisors and Managers Fairness Act, and the Strengthening Supply Chains Through Truck Driver Incentives Act.  I’m working to restore the Hudson Valley as a manufacturing hub in our nation, and part of that is bolstering our global competitiveness, which is why I support legislation like the China Financial Threat Mitigation Act and the No Tax Breaks for Outsourcing Act. As a former small business owner, I know the hard work and dedication that it takes to sustain and grow a business. Our family-owned businesses are the drivers of our local economies and I’m fighting day in and day out to get them the resources they need to thrive. I’m working to secure federal funds to help grow our local economies, like the $70,000 I delivered for the Hudson Valley Regional Council to grow emerging sectors like advanced manufacturing, clean energy, and technology. Ensuring Safety for All | Congressman Pat Ryan Skip to main content Ensuring Safety for All Image Hudson Valley families deserve to feel safe when they walk the streets of their neighborhood or take a trip downtown. When our brave first responders are equipped with the resources they need for their around-the-clock work, we’re all safer. That’s why I champion legislation like the Invest to Protect Act that will provide more funding for law enforcement departments that serve smaller communities and will keep fighting every day to deliver the federal funding and support that our heroes deserve.  BOLSTERING PUBLIC SAFETY IN DUTCHESS COUNTY Earlier this year, I joined with Dutchess County Sheriff Kirk Imperati, Dutchess County Executive Sue Serino, and Dutchess County District Attorney Anthony Parisi to announce our joint work to bolster public safety in Dutchess County. That includes  my fight for over $2.3 million in federal funding to invest in cutting-edge technology upgrades that will help develop a consolidated two-way public safety radio system for first responders throughout the entire county to improve emergency response coordination and cut down on crime by modernizing the Sheriff’s Office’s Analysis and Real Time Crime Intelligence Center.  Image   Only months after that,  I helped secure over $3 million in federal funding for the county to crack down on hate crimes, protect domestic violence and sexual assault survivors and prosecute perpetrators, and boost capacity for DNA testing of evidence. I was proud to  deliver the $375,000 in federal funding necessary for the Town of Poughkeepsie to hire more officers to create a brand new Community Policing Unit that is dedicated to community outreach, addressing chronic crime issues like larceny, and remediating quality of life issues within the community.  “ This funding is evidence of Congressman Ryan’s strong commitment to public safety, and will go a long way towards helping law enforcement deal with the many issues facing our communities today. Government that Works for All | Congressman Pat Ryan Skip to main content Government that Works for All Image Too often, politicians feel too far away, out of reach and out of touch. They make empty, hollow promises or put personal ambition and extremist agendas before our communities and country. That’s not what I learned growing up here or at West Point, that’s not how I guided my troops in Iraq, that isn’t how I served as Ulster County Executive, and that’s not what I’m bringing to Washington now. I serve you and I’m committed to bringing government assistance directly to you. Hearing from each and every voice in the Hudson Valley is critical for me to best represent you in Congress. In 2024 alone, 23,530 families from across NY-18 joined me for conversations about Hudson Valley priorities during my telephone townhalls.  Image   BRINGING MY OFFICE TO YOU WITH THE C.A.R.E.S. VAN  My team goes the extra mile to cut through bureaucratic red tape and get you the results you deserve with the C.A.R.E.S. Van. Within only months of hitting the road in June of 2023, the C.A.R.E.S. Van brought direct assistance to every one of NY-18’s 82 municipalities. Since then, it’s made 164 visits to our Hudson Valley communities, with over 150 of our neighbors at a single event.  With the C.A.R.E.S. Van, we delivered flood recovery resources directly to communities impacted by last year’s catastrophic flooding, connected Central Hudson representatives with ratepayers for one-on-one assistance, brought the Social Security Administration back to Ulster County and Newburgh, and gathered dozens of community partners together for resource fairs for seniors, veterans, and military families. Image   SECURING MILLIONS IN FUNDS FOR OUR NEIGHBORS I’m also proud to have opened three offices throughout the 18th District - one in each county, to ensure that you have reliable access to my office and assistance that you can count on. That’s how my team helped return  $30 million to Hudson Valley families that federal agencies owed them. Clean Air, Soil, and Water for All | Congressman Pat Ryan Skip to main content Clean Air, Soil, and Water for All Image Every Hudson Valley family should be able to turn on the faucet and have the peace of mind knowing the water is clean and safe; they should be able to let their children run around on the playground without worrying about toxins or contaminants. Everyone deserves clean air, water, and soil - that’s what I’m fighting for. FIGHTING TOXIC ‘FOREVER CHEMICALS’ As a member of the Congressional PFAS Task Force, I introduced the historic PFAS Action Act, the most comprehensive legislation to combat “forever chemicals” in our drinking water and household goods to date. Since its introduction, multiple provisions of the Act have been  adapted by the Environmental Protection Agency for enforcement, including establishing a nationwide limit for the amount of PFAS in drinking water. I’ve repeatedly called for the accelerated cleanup of PFAS contamination at Stewart Air National Guard Base in Newburgh and am fighting for the Department of Defense PFAS Discharge Prevention Act. GETTING LEAD OUT OF OUR COMMUNITIES No amount of lead exposure is safe for kids, no matter what the source is - lead pipes in water systems, aerial lead-sheathed telecommunications cables over playgrounds, or paint in homes. I’m fighting to get the lead out of our communities. I brought the Environmental Protection Agency to Poughkeepsie to help the city address the lead pipe crisis and secure federal funds to remove them. I was proud to join with Governor Hochul earlier this year to announce nearly  $12 million for Poughkeepsie to replace lead pipes in its water system, including funding from the historic Bipartisan Infrastructure Law (BIL).  The BIL includes $15 billion  in funding for lead pipe replacement across the country and you better believe I’ll keep working every day to bring more of those investments home to the Hudson Valley to protect our families from toxic lead exposures.
